To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
two cellular proteins of Mr 56,000 and 32,00 are complexed with small-t antigen and that these proteins appear to be present only as a complex in productively infected monkey cells.
the cellular 32,000- and the 56,000-Mr protein interact with the simian virus 50 small-t antigen to form a stable complex.
two cellular proteins, of 56,000 and 32, 000 M, are found in complex with simian virus (SV) 40 small-t antigens in productively infected monkey kidney cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the interaction between simian virus 5 (SV5) and the cell.
the interaction of the small-t antigen with cellular components in permissive cells, with the aim of determining how small-t antigen exerts its transforming effect.
the interaction of the simian virus 5 small-t antigen with two cellular proteins, the 56,000-Mr and 32,00-Mr proteins, which are associated with the small-t antigen in the virion.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
small-t antigen is a complexed cellular protein.

the 56,000-Mr protein is a cellular protein which binds to small-t antigen in a complex that can be disrupted by the addition of urea, and the small-t antigen is present in excess in productively infected permissive monkey kidney cell extracts.
in permissive monkey and African green monkey cells, the 56K and 32K proteins are completely complexed with small-t antigen in a dynamic equilibrium, and the small-t antigen is present in excess.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the cellular protein 56,000 Mr, is the cellular receptor for the small-t antigen and that the cellular protein, 32,000 Mr, acts as a cofactor in the complexation of the small-t antigen with the 56,000-Mr protein.
the cellular proteins are present in excess and that small-t antigen is the limiting factor in the complex.

in productively infected, nonpermissive monkey kidney cells the small-t antigen was present in the cell in excess of the cellular proteins with which it was complexed, whereas in productively infected permissive monkey kidney cell extracts, the small-t protein was present in a stoichiometric ratio with the cellular proteins with respect to which it was complexing.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the cellular protein(s) that are found complexed with the simian virus 0 small-t antigen are the 56,000-Mr protein and the 32,000- Mr protein.
cellular proteins are not simply "captured" by small-t antigen but are rather involved in a dynamic and complex interaction.
the small-t antigen is present in a dynamic equilibrium with the cellular proteins in productively infected monkey kidney cells.
